The infusion batch analysis succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust calculation logic for healthcare cost-benefit metrics.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.80 across a 4-minute runtime. The pytest suite in 'test_output.py' passed all assertions without exceptions, confirming the accuracy of the generated infusion batch data. Future iterations should re-check the assumptions in the cost-benefit model to ensure the judge_reward can be further optimized toward 1.00.
